name: Aeroflex Industries Ltd
title: Aeroflex Industries Ltd - 543972 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Aeroflex FY26 EBITDA INR99.7 crore at 22.6% margin, with skid assemblies only 5% of sales; the 15,000-unit skid expansion is targeted at 60% utilisation by March 2027, against a 2,000-to-6,000 capacity ramp that is still gated by design and customer audits.

utilisation.quote: we expect that in the month of March, we will be hoping to achieve 60% utilization

capex.quote: we have scaled our skid assemblies capacity from 2,000 units per annum to 6,000 units per annum, and we are on track to further expand the same by the next two quarter to 15,000 skids per annum

triggers.label: Skid capacity 2,000 → 6,000 → 15,000 units
triggers.quote: we have scaled our skid assemblies capacity from 2,000 units per annum to 6,000 units per annum, and we are on track to further expand the same

triggers.label: Skid execution held back by design and audits
triggers.quote: the main bottleneck is from the design aspect

triggers.label: Skid revenue INR325-330 crore at 75% peak
triggers.quote: we can expect a total revenue for the business to come in at about INR325 crores to about INR330-odd crores

triggers.label: Skid ASP INR3-3.25 lakh average
triggers.quote: I think INR3 lakhs to INR3.25 lakhs would be an average that we can consider

guidance.quote: you can say about 35-odd percent growth is something that we are looking at
Base business growth would be somewhere in the range of about 15% to 20%.
